commentary: With market breadth scoring 49 and benchmarks diverging amid large-cap banking rotation, our disciplined framework mandates caution. As Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil established, index advances unsupported by broad small and mid-cap participation signal institutional distribution and selective rotation rather than broad-based Stage 2 expansion. Legendary market operators prioritize capital preservation over action: leading setups must possess accelerating earnings growth (CANSLIM C&A) and tight volatility contraction above a rising 30-week moving average. In this selective tape, authentic institutional leaders like Aditya Birla Capital and Aarti Surfactants stand out, while laggards lacking fundamental acceleration must be avoided. As Jesse Livermore warned, respect the general market tone and enforce strict stops.
